access_limits: Connected search service failed with a transport error; used the web search fallback.
X native search and two original status URLs returned HTTP 403; no authenticated timeline was collected.
Jev-X initially returned a page header dated 11/06 UTC, but subsequent reads timed out; its feed was not reviewed.
arXiv API attempts failed; this was not a completed API sweep. Primary arXiv web pages were available.
findings: No new eligible paper verified in this round; this does not establish absence of new papers on X.
Recent paper leads resolved to existing catalogue entries. Three were selected for a weekly reading shortlist using primary sources, without asserting a verified weekly X post.
Personal demonstrations and blog benchmarks were retained separately from papers.

findings.round: same-day CN-platform supplement (after the X-only morning round)
findings.result: No platform-independent new arXiv records: Ant 27B -> SII-Decision-27B (2610.03935, catalogued); Jev-DLC -> 2610.31521; StartLux -> 2610.17309; LLM2Jev -> 2610.02076 v2 (catalogued as LLM-as-Jev); Jev in the Wild -> 2609.30216. The X cross-check summary, however, surfaced EarthJev (2611.02096, first submitted 11-01) which no API query had ever matched (Jev token only fused inside EarthJev/OneJev); it was verified via its arXiv abstract page, submission history and PDF body, and added by the same-day arXiv round 11.
